name: pilot-10k-2048
description: Exploratory pilot cell: 10,240 requested input tokens with a 2048-token output ceiling, one concurrency level per run. It exists to observe how long responses actually run at 10k input, because the 256-token screening ceiling censored 117 of 120 responses and the three natural completions (217-249 tokens) do not identify the tail above 256. A clean pilot does not certify the ceiling: with zero censoring in 40 trials the one-sided 95% exact upper bound on the censoring probability is about 7.2%, and dependence or drift weaken even that. A pilot truncation triggers review, not automatic cap escalation.

qualification.note: Pilot evidence is exploratory. It must not be relabelled as qualification evidence after thresholds are chosen. The pilot is only suggestive, never confirmatory.
